title: Search for Springfield Population and Enter into Excel
goal: Search for Springfield's population in 2024 on the Searchly website, retrieve the data, and enter it into an Excel spreadsheet.
summary: The workflow begins by searching for Springfield's population in 2024 on the Searchly website. The results are accessed, and the data is then transferred to Excel. The user enters the population value 186,412 into the appropriate cell in the spreadsheet.
prerequisites: The user has access to the Searchly website and the Excel application.
The file 'City Research.xlsx' is available and loaded in Excel.

inputs.name: population_value
inputs.description: The population value for Springfield in 2024 that is to be entered into the Excel cell.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.description: The Excel file containing the data about Springfield.

inputs.name: city_name
inputs.description: The city name used in the data entry process.

inputs.name: source_url
inputs.description: The URL of the search results page from Searchly.

open_questions: The user's action of switching to Excel is confirmed, but is there any indication of a potential error in the switch? The user may have intended to switch to a different application or file.

steps.uncertainty_reason: The user's action is confirmed by the change in the URL and the appearance of the data on the page.

steps.uncertainty_reason: The user's action is confirmed by the change in the active window from Searchly to Excel, and the visible data in the spreadsheet.
